title: Story premise EDU046: The Directions Need a Landmark
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (language/communication). Hook: Left from whose point of view? Takeaway/theme: Directions become clearer when the starting point and frame of reference are explicit.
description: A visitor wants to find a room, but left-right instructions change meaning when the starting orientation changes. A fixed landmark and a simple route sketch give the visitor a stable reference.
